order: Serial first on odd rounds; parallel first on even rounds.
state_after_error: Host four-thread ABI: 8 invalid inputs per policy return 2 before workspace/output changes; both policies recover using the same workspace.
scan_scope: Serial Q/K cover full scans. Parallel Q/K cover the two local slices on the last-finishing core selected in each run. Combined elapsed time includes dispatch and join. Percentages are per-run ratios to instrumented forward wall time.

versions.target: riscv64 / RV64GC / LP64D / QEMU virt / bare metal

arithmetic_policy: External FP32 blocked_fma, scalar RV64, runtime-panel 4x4 microkernel, eight-block dynamic claims, parallel copy after success
decision: Keep serial input checks in the selected Attention candidate. The scan is faster in isolation; plain forward does not demonstrate a benefit from this change.
